entries.name: 100-200 item benchmarks rarely resolve a 5-point accuracy gap
entries.summary: Simulation: on a binary-scored benchmark near 70% accuracy, a paired bootstrap 95% CI detects a true 5-point gap in only 13-19% of 100-item comparisons and 20-34% of 200-item ones; at 500 items detection rises to 51-76%. Median CI half-widths are 7.5-11.0 pp at n=100, 5.3-7.8 pp at n=200, and 3.4-4.9 pp at n=500.
